title: North Shore Parasail
specs: Flights ascend to 600 or 800 feet for panoramic views
Safe and smooth flights with zero incidents in 36 years
Takeoffs and landings from the back of the boat, no water contact required
Flyers must be at least 5 years old and 45 lbs
Guests under 18 must have an adult sign them in
Pregnant women not allowed to parasail or ride on the boat
Guests with certain injuries should refrain from parasailing or riding on the boat
Tandem and triple flights available; combined weight limits apply
Groups of 6 or more get a discount; call for details
Group discounts available at some locations for groups of 8 or more

blurb: Guests parasail from a boat, ascending to 600 or 800 feet for panoramic views of coastal and lake locations. Flights last 8 to 10 minutes, with boat trips about one hour. Professional crew handles all operations; no experience or swimming skills required.
